description: Wim van Ackooij and co-authors document the StOpt library’s role in plan4res seasonal-storage valuation. The native description identifies a multistage stochastic convex optimisation problem and explains why stochastic dual dynamic programming is suitable for its scale. It describes the existing open-source StOpt library and how it can fit into the SMS++ solver structure. Zenodo provides the deliverable PDF freely under CC BY 4.0; separate library distribution and licence terms are not supplied by this deposit. Coverage is generic seasonal energy-storage valuation within the plan4res framework, with system-specific years and geography selected by a model application. The related SMS++ record describes a distinct solver framework. A limitation is that the metadata does not specify input schemas, convergence settings or validation tests. No PDF body or source code was downloaded, and no optimisation run was reproduced.
